description: All business logic services (auth, user, lead, customer, deal, activity, dashboard). Depends on FEAT-001 (models) and FEAT-002 (timeline service). The lead.convertLead service uses MongoDB transactions — the most complex piece of logic in the entire project.
steps: Create backend/src/services/auth.service.js: const { User } = require('../models/User.model'); const jwtConfig = require('../config/jwt'); const AppError = require('../utils/AppError'). exports.register = async(data) => { check email uniqueness (duplicate caught by errorHandler); const user = await User.create(data); const accessToken = jwtConfig.generateAccessToken({id:user._id,role:user.role}); const refreshToken = jwtConfig.generateRefreshToken({id:user._id}); user.refreshToken=refreshToken; await user.save(); return { user: sanitizeUser(user), accessToken, refreshToken }; }. exports.login = async(email,password) => { const user = await User.findOne({email,isActive:true}).select('+password +refreshToken'); if(!user||!await user.comparePassword(password)) throw new AppError('Invalid credentials',401); const accessToken=jwtConfig.generateAccessToken({id:user._id,role:user.role}); const refreshToken=jwtConfig.generateRefreshToken({id:user._id}); user.refreshToken=refreshToken; await user.save(); return { user:sanitizeUser(user), accessToken, refreshToken }; }. exports.logout = async(userId) => { await User.findByIdAndUpdate(userId,{refreshToken:null}); }. exports.refreshTokens = async(token) => { const decoded=jwtConfig.verifyRefreshToken(token); const user=await User.findById(decoded.id).select('+refreshToken'); if(!user||user.refreshToken!==token) throw new AppError('Invalid refresh token',401); const accessToken=jwtConfig.generateAccessToken({id:user._id,role:user.role}); const refreshToken=jwtConfig.generateRefreshToken({id:user._id}); user.refreshToken=refreshToken; await user.save(); return { accessToken, refreshToken }; }.

Create backend/src/services/user.service.js: CRUD wrapping User model. getAllUsers(filters={},page=1,limit=10): build query from filters (role, isActive, search on name/email), paginate, populate nothing. getUserById(id): findById, throw AppError(404) if not found. createUser(data): User.create(data). updateUser(id,data): findByIdAndUpdate with {new:true,runValidators:true}, never allow password change here (strip password from data). deleteUser(id): soft-delete — findByIdAndUpdate({isActive:false}). All return sanitized user objects.

Create backend/src/services/lead.service.js: getAllLeads(filters={},user,page=1,limit=10,sort='-createdAt'): if user.role==='sales_executive' set filters.assignedTo=user._id; build mongoose query with populate('assignedTo','name email').populate('createdBy','name'); paginate and sort. getLead(id,user): findById+populate; if sales_executive and lead.assignedTo!=user._id throw AppError(403). createLead(data): Lead.create(data); call TimelineService.createTimelineEntry({action:'Lead created',...}). updateLead(id,data,performedBy): findById, store previous values, update, createTimelineEntry. deleteLead(id): findByIdAndDelete. updateLeadStatus(id,status,performedBy): findById, previousValue={status:lead.status}, update status, createTimelineEntry({action:'Status changed',...}). assignLead(id,assigneeId,performedBy): verify assignee exists (User.findById), update lead, createTimelineEntry. convertLead(id,{dealTitle,dealValue,dealStage,expectedCloseDate,customerData},performedBy): USE TRANSACTION — const session=await mongoose.startSession(); session.startTransaction(); try { const lead=await Lead.findById(id).session(session); if(!lead) throw AppError(404); if(lead.status==='converted') throw AppError(400,'Already converted'); const customer=await Customer.create([{name:lead.name,email:lead.email,phone:lead.phone,company:lead.company,...customerData,originalLead:lead._id,assignedTo:lead.assignedTo,createdBy:performedBy}],{session}); const deal=await Deal.create([{title:dealTitle,lead:lead._id,customer:customer[0]._id,assignedTo:lead.assignedTo,value:dealValue,stage:dealStage||'qualification',expectedCloseDate,createdBy:performedBy}],{session}); await Lead.findByIdAndUpdate(id,{status:'converted',convertedAt:new Date(),convertedCustomer:customer[0]._id,convertedDeal:deal[0]._id},{session}); await TimelineService.createTimelineEntry({action:'Lead converted to customer',entityType:'lead',entityId:id,performedBy,session}); await TimelineService.createTimelineEntry({action:'Customer created from lead',entityType:'customer',entityId:customer[0]._id,performedBy,session}); await TimelineService.createTimelineEntry({action:'Deal created from lead',entityType:'deal',entityId:deal[0]._id,performedBy,session}); await session.commitTransaction(); return { customer:customer[0], deal:deal[0] }; } catch(err) { await session.abortTransaction(); throw err; } finally { session.endSession(); }

Create backend/src/services/customer.service.js: getAllCustomers(filters,user,page,limit,sort): if sales_executive filter by assignedTo. getCustomer(id): findById+populate. createCustomer(data): Customer.create, createTimelineEntry. updateCustomer(id,data,performedBy): findByIdAndUpdate, createTimelineEntry({action:'Customer updated',...}). deleteCustomer(id): findByIdAndDelete.

Create backend/src/services/deal.service.js: getAllDeals(filters,user,page,limit,sort): if sales_executive filter by assignedTo. getDeal(id): findById+populate lead,customer,assignedTo. createDeal(data): Deal.create, createTimelineEntry. updateDeal(id,data,performedBy): findByIdAndUpdate, createTimelineEntry. deleteDeal(id): findByIdAndDelete. updateDealStage(id,{stage,lostReason,value,probability,expectedCloseDate},performedBy,userRole): const deal=await Deal.findById(id); const currentStage=deal.stage; const terminalStages=['won','lost']; if(terminalStages.includes(currentStage)&&userRole!=='admin') throw AppError(403,'Cannot change stage of won/lost deal'); if(stage==='won'){if(!deal.value&&!value) throw AppError(400,'Deal value required'); if((probability||deal.probability)!==100) throw AppError(400,'Probability must be 100 for won deal'); if(!expectedCloseDate&&!deal.expectedCloseDate) throw AppError(400,'Expected close date required');} if(stage==='lost'&&!lostReason) throw AppError(400,'Lost reason required'); const updateData={stage,...(lostReason&&{lostReason}),...(value&&{value}),...(probability!==undefined&&{probability}),...(expectedCloseDate&&{expectedCloseDate})}; const updated=await Deal.findByIdAndUpdate(id,updateData,{new:true,runValidators:true}); await TimelineService.createTimelineEntry({action:`Stage changed: ${currentStage} → ${stage}`,entityType:'deal',entityId:id,performedBy,previousValue:{stage:currentStage},newValue:{stage}}); return updated;

Create backend/src/services/activity.service.js: getAllActivities(filters,user,page,limit,sort): first call markOverdueActivities() to refresh statuses; if sales_executive filter by assignedTo. getActivity(id): findById+populate. createActivity(data): Activity.create, createTimelineEntry. updateActivity(id,data,performedBy): findByIdAndUpdate. deleteActivity(id): findByIdAndDelete. completeActivity(id,performedBy): findById; if already completed throw AppError(400); update {status:'completed',completedAt:new Date()}; createTimelineEntry({action:'Activity completed',...relatedTo as entityId/entityType}). markOverdueActivities(): Activity.updateMany({dueDate:{$lt:new Date()},status:'pending'},{$set:{status:'overdue'}}).

Create backend/src/services/dashboard.service.js: getStats(): Promise.all([ Lead.aggregate([{$group:{_id:'$status',count:{$sum:1}}}]), Deal.aggregate([{$group:{_id:'$stage',count:{$sum:1},totalValue:{$sum:'$value'}}}]), Deal.countDocuments({stage:'won'}), Deal.countDocuments({stage:{$in:['won','lost']}}), Lead.countDocuments({status:'converted'}), Lead.countDocuments() ]); compute winRate=(won/closedDeals*100)||0, conversionRate=(convertedLeads/totalLeads*100)||0; return structured stats. getPipeline(): Deal.aggregate([{$match:{stage:{$nin:['won','lost']}}},{$group:{_id:'$stage',count:{$sum:1},totalValue:{$sum:'$value'},avgProbability:{$avg:'$probability'}}}]). getTeamPerformance(startDate,endDate): User.aggregate with $lookup on deals won in date range, group by user. getRecentActivities(limit=10): Activity.find().sort({createdAt:-1}).limit(limit).populate('assignedTo','name').populate('createdBy','name').
acceptance_criteria: auth.service.js exports register, login, logout, refreshTokens
lead.service.js exports convertLead which uses mongoose session/transaction
deal.service.js exports updateDealStage with transition validation
dashboard.service.js exports getStats, getPipeline, getTeamPerformance, getRecentActivities
All services import from correct relative paths (../../models/ etc.)
node require of each service file succeeds without errors
verification: node -e "const s=require('./src/services/dashboard.service'); console.log(Object.keys(s))" — prints all 4 method names
findings: All 7 service files created and verified. auth.service exports [register,login,logout,refreshTokens]. lead.service.convertLead uses mongoose session+transaction with array-form Model.create(). deal.service.updateDealStage enforces won/lost validation and terminal-stage admin guard. activity.service.markOverdueActivities called at start of getAllActivities. dashboard.service exports getStats,getPipeline,getTeamPerformance,getRecentActivities. All node require checks pass.
